Resolvent boundary conditions yield the algebraic generating function with correct c0=1. Algebraic singularities, positive residues and square-root transfer give the four regimes, including both collisions; evaluating r(1) gives the absolutely summable Green–Kubo variance and derivatives. Reproducible checker has 699 successful exact identities and finite diagnostics including direct branch-cell integrations, but infinite statements use the given proof. Limitations: fixed-parameter asymptotics, central coordinate only, no CLT.

value.rationale: The central coordinate is singled out in the published dynamical review as capturing essential heterochaos memory and was investigated with costly numerical autocorrelation experiments. This exact result resolves a natural previously numerical observable for every model parameter, distinguishes two off-neutral pole–branch resonance thresholds from the neutral Lyapunov transition, and establishes a sharp parameter-dependent Green–Kubo maximum and cusp, giving usable quantitative temporal information absent from qualitative mixing rates. It is a structural full-parameter classification, not a textbook restatement, arbitrary finite slice or tiny numerical increment.
